designs.name: All Things
designs.story_or_verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

designs.name: Be Still
designs.story_or_verse: Be still, and know that I am God.

designs.name: Better Together
designs.story_or_verse: His and hers. Same heart, matching fit.

designs.name: Glory in the Highest
designs.story_or_verse: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

designs.name: God Dey
designs.story_or_verse: Naija mood, every day. He is present, He is faithful, and we are not shaken.

designs.name: Grace Dey Load
designs.story_or_verse: When it looks like the data is finished, grace is still loading.

designs.name: I Am My Beloved's
designs.story_or_verse: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine.

designs.name: I Shall Not Want
designs.story_or_verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

designs.name: It Is Written
designs.story_or_verse: It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

designs.name: Lamp Unto My Feet
designs.story_or_verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

designs.name: Let There Be Light
designs.story_or_verse: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

designs.name: Let Your Light
designs.story_or_verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

designs.name: No Shaking
designs.story_or_verse: Calm. Covered. Not moved by the noise.

designs.name: Nothing Impossible
designs.story_or_verse: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

designs.name: Seek First
designs.story_or_verse: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

designs.name: Substance of Faith
designs.story_or_verse: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

designs.name: The Word
designs.story_or_verse: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

designs.name: Trust in the Lord
designs.story_or_verse: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

designs.name: Two Are Better
designs.story_or_verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

designs.name: Unto Us
designs.story_or_verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given.
